about.title: About
about.lead: Flowstate is a Montreal studio. We rebuild websites and we make new ones.
about.body: Most of the work is restaurants, diners, trades, clinics — places with a phone number and a live site that no longer matches the room. We read what they actually print. We don’t invent hours, dollar prices, or a booking tool they don’t have. English-first when that’s their site. French when they need it.
